The trigger computes revision as MAX+1 without a lock beyond the agent_skills row lock; two concurrent inserts of the same skill id on a restore after a delete would collide on the unique (skill_id, revision) and surface as an internal error.

Migration 0064 adds the table skill_revisions and the trigger agent_skills_revision_trg. Every insert, update or delete of a skill logs a revision with the actor. Writers name themselves with transaction-local settings (mp.actor_kind, mp.actor_id, mp.run_id, mp.thread_id, mp.reason, mp.skill_action). A writer that names nobody is logged as 'unattributed'. An update that only touches updated_at is skipped. Snapshots over 64 KB are stored as a truncated marker. The newest 50 revisions of each skill are kept. A revert file ships beside it.

session-core (grpc.rs):
- upsert_agent_skill and set_agent_skill_enabled now run in a transaction that names the actor. set_agent_skill_enabled previously ran on the pool without one.
- UpsertAgentSkillResponse.revision and AgentSkill.revision are now filled.
- New service LearningGovernanceService, registered with the interceptor, with three RPCs. I made it a separate service so the five SessionCore mocks in model-gateway and execution-core keep compiling, the same way MessageSearch was added.
  - DecideSkillProposal: owner only, proposed rows only. Accept enables the skill; reject disables it. ZDR credentials are refused.
  - UndoLearningEntry: owner only, newest entry of a skill only, refused if already undone, truncated or the name is now taken. It restores the before-snapshot, deletes the skill if the entry created it, and marks undone_by.
  - ListLearningLedger: owner only, newest first, keyset cursor. It returns skill revisions plus extractor-written memories, and memories are gated by the same state as the memory list.
- gdpr.rs: skill_revisions is purged after agent_skills, because deleting a skill writes a 'deleted' revision that holds its text. The order is pinned by a test.

capability-core (registry_apis.go): PATCH, DELETE and POST run in a transaction that sets the actor from the verified principal, never from the body. POST accepts promoted_from (admin, scope org only, the source must be an accepted user skill shared with the caller). It is recorded as 'promoted'. A database without Begin refuses skill mutations. I added two fields to the shared test fake in mcp_auth_test.go and its Begin in the new test file.

depth_findings.text: Subagent children share the parent's run_id and runtime_loop/mod.rs `run_inputs::global().get(org_id, run_id)` hands them the parent's attached files in code_interpreter; plan requires no inheritance. Needs a shared-edit in mod.rs (pass depth or a root-only flag to the lookup).

Do runs that await approval or park return from run_agent, so the RunInputs guard drops and the files are gone on the continuation segment or in-place resume, while the restored messages still hold the sandbox note saying attachments/ exists; plan v1 wants a typed attachments_expired signal instead. Images are likewise not re-sent after a resume.

RunInputs TTL is 15 minutes (run_inputs.rs, not owned) and is swept on the next registration, so a Do run longer than 15 minutes can lose its files mid-run; TTL should be refreshed or derived from the run deadline.

Server-declared gate missing: attachment_policy.rs needs modes.do_attachments (and chat-client.ts parseAttachmentPolicy the field) so the FE can read it from /v1/models instead of the build-time VITE_CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED; compose pass-through for CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED is also not added (deploy/docker-compose.yml not owned).

Golden rows (Do, attachment, ZDR) in zdr_feature_table.rs / zdr_posture_matrix.rs [live-only] and the Go mirror of the field-20 wire parity test are not written; an end-to-end gateway test that a Do turn with the switch on reaches RunAgentRequest.attachments (via invoke_stream_sse) is not written, only the pure builder and helper tests.

do_run_attachments in sse.rs duplicates the image mime/base64 decode of vision_parts::ImageParts::from_validated; expose the decoded bytes there and delete the copy. Cloning file bytes out of ValidatedAttachments leaves one non-zeroed transient copy per Do turn.

Images on a Do turn are checked against the catalogue only when it is readable; when it is not, inference-core's fail-closed vision_unsupported ends a round mid-run rather than refusing before the run exists.
Persisted thread text does not hold the image (follow-ups cannot re-read it), same as Ask S4; and the FE Do path sending kind:'file' bytes depends on S5's modes.sandbox_files, not wired here.

Subagent children still inherit the attached FILES. A child is built with `req: parent.req` and the parent's run_id, and `runtime_loop/mod.rs:893` calls `run_inputs::global().get(org_id, run_id)` with no depth check, so a child's code_interpreter reads `attachments/`. The plan says children do not inherit attachments. The test `children_do_not_inherit_attachments` covers only images and the note. The fix is a shared edit in mod.rs: pass depth or a root-only flag into the lookup, and add a test where a child code_interpreter step sees no files. Must land before the switch is turned on.

A parked, resumed or continuation Do run loses its files, because the RunInputs guard lives only inside the run_agent call. The restored messages still hold the sandbox note saying `attachments/` exists, and images are not re-sent (`image_parts` is empty on the restored and parked paths). The plan wants a typed `attachments_expired` refusal or signal instead of a silent mismatch.

The run-inputs TTL (15 minutes, in run_inputs.rs, not owned) is swept on the next registration, so a Do run longer than 15 minutes can lose its files mid-run. Derive the TTL from the run deadline or refresh it while the guard is alive.

The server-declared gate is missing: `attachment_policy.rs` needs `modes.do_attachments`, and `parseAttachmentPolicy` in chat-client.ts needs to read it. Until then the composer reads the build-time VITE_CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED and can drift from the server switch. The `CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED` pass-through in deploy/docker-compose.yml is also not added, so the switch cannot reach a deployed model-gateway container.

There is no end-to-end gateway test that a Do turn with the switch on carries its attachments through `invoke_stream_sse` into `RunAgentRequest.attachments`. Only the pure builder, the helper and the request-builder tests exist. The golden rows (Do, attachment, ZDR) in zdr_feature_table.rs and zdr_posture_matrix.rs, and `bash scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh`, are also still to do.

The scrub_checkpoint_test addition only shows that the fold has no field an attachment could ride in, and that a hand-built note is not credential-shaped. It never drives a real saved checkpoint from a run that carries attachments.

`image_parts: image_parts.clone()` copies every image's bytes on every round, and the clones are not zeroed. The gateway's `do_run_attachments` and the clone of ValidatedAttachments' file bytes leave transient copies as well. Use shared bytes (`Arc` or `Bytes`) or hand over the parts by reference, and zero them on drop.

When the catalogue is unreadable, an image on a Do turn is not refused before the run exists. inference-core's `vision_unsupported` later ends a round in mid-run. This is a documented choice; consider refusing up front when the catalogue read fails and the switch is on.
Persisted thread text does not hold the image, so follow-up turns cannot re-read it. FE Do turns that send kind:'file' bytes also depend on S5's modes.sandbox_files, which is not wired here.

The Go mirror of the field-20 wire-parity golden is not written (go/gen/model_plane/v1/proto_wire_parity_execution_test.go). Go bindings have not been regenerated for execution.proto, and `buf breaking` has not been run.

In sse.rs the doc comment `One-shot SSE stream that emits a single structured error...` is now attached to the new DO_ATTACHMENTS_VAR constant, and `error_stream` has lost it. Move the new block above that comment.
`do_run_attachments` duplicates the image mime and base64 decode in vision_parts::ImageParts::from_validated. Expose the decoded bytes there and delete the copy.
